title: Iron in the Ranks
summary: The dead on the high road march in rows now. Go and look, then kill 5 of them.
ask: Gus: Come up here, and keep your voice down.
Gus: The dead on the high road have got helmets now. Dented, mismatched, but helmets. And they stand in rows. The dead never used to care about rows.

steps.text: Look at them from the ridge
done: Eight of them, shoulder to shoulder, facing nothing. One has a shield strapped to its arm.

start: The nearest one turns its head. The whole row turns after it.
done: Five down. The rest wander off, rows forgotten.
Gus: Shields. I knew it. Something is giving orders out there.
Gus: Take this. For the knees you saved me from climbing.
